end.summary:
Discussed that families can differ in size and members.
Discussed how family members share care and household work.
Trisha initially said children cannot help with family work.
Later, Trisha gave examples of putting toys away and carrying a glass to help.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised different family structures and why sharing household work helps everyone. Trisha correctly identified that a small family and a large family are both families, and later gave examples of helping by putting toys away and carrying a glass. The idea that only grown-ups can help was corrected later in the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to choose one safe household task, such as putting away toys or placing napkins.
